title: BenchMIRT: What are LLM benchmarks actually measuring?
summary: 本文探讨了LLM基准测试的实际测量内容，指出传统基准可能高估模型能力，并提出BenchMIRT框架以更准确评估模型推理与理解。
highlights: Benchmarks often conflate memorization with reasoning, leading to inflated performance scores.
The proposed BenchMIRT framework separates core reasoning from auxiliary skills to provide clearer insights.
Current evaluation methods may not reflect real-world generalization, necessitating more targeted tests.
